summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching an ASX Appendix 2A application for quotation of 408,839,531 ordinary fully paid shares issued as part of a previously announced placement. The filing also indicates further issues of 40,000,000 ordinary shares and options/warrants remain to complete the transaction. This is a routine administrative listing application by the issuer, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are disclosed; the event is purely a securities quotation request.
